name: pi-desktop-public-rpc-bridge
protocol: Pi Coding Agent public LF-delimited RPC
providerManagement: Selected Pi public ModelRuntime SDK in external Node worker
historyManagement: Public extension command context navigateTree and fork(position: at)
configurationManagement: Selected public SettingsManager, DefaultPackageManager and ProjectTrustStore in external Node; native Markdown and MCP configuration files
packageManagement: Selected public DefaultPackageManager in a separate Node job, with protocol output on fd 3 and joined process-tree cancellation
resourceReload: Public extension command context reload; native conflict precedence and explicit per-process --no-extensions recovery
packageDiscovery: Read-only official pi.dev gallery and public npm manifests; whole-package native installation
skillPresentation: Read-only native skill expansion with preserved source text and concise discovered titles
historyPreview: Read-only Pi v3 active-branch preview before native RPC readiness; unknown formats defer to Pi
contextUsage: Optional public get_session_stats contextUsage, refreshed at native message boundaries and state changes
contextComposition: Character counts by source from public extension metadata, normalized and sorted by share
cacheUsage: Session-wide cacheRead / (input + cacheRead + cacheWrite) from public get_session_stats
completionNotifications: Persisted assistant entry after public agent_settled; tool steps, cancellation, history navigation and resume do not notify
thinkingPresentation: Native thinking_start/delta/end; complete summaries replace partial text before message_end
contextDisplay: Last complete reply after public agent_settled; hidden before completion and frozen during tools, streaming, cancellation and idle metadata changes
sessionTitles: After public agent_settled, the selected model summarizes the first user message through modelRegistry.streamSimple; setSessionName persists native history
